t: High-powered and optimised using multi-material technology to cut mild steel, non-ferrous metals, wood, wood with embedded nails and plastic with a single blade. Balanced, lightweight and compact, delivering a maximum cutting depth of 53mm. Integrated dust blower allows optimum visibility along cutting line. Quick-adjust bevel lever and clear, debossed angle markings improves ease and accuracy of bevel cuts. Safety features include a lock-off switch, electronic blade brake and spindle lock for easy blade changes. Over-moulded handle improves ergonomics and comfort. Includes housing on-board tool storage for blade change hex key. Power cord length 3m. Supplied with 165mm TCT blade, hex key and parallel guide.
